name: bot-panel
description: Admin panel for managing Discord bots on VPS

scripts.reinstall:client: cd client && node -e "fs.rmSync('node_modules', {recursive:true, force:true})" && npm install --include=dev --no-save
scripts.reinstall:all: node -e "fs.rmSync('node_modules', {recursive:true, force:true})" && npm install --include=dev --no-save && npm run install:agent && cd client && node -e "fs.rmSync('node_modules', {recursive:true, force:true})" && npm install --include=dev --no-save
scripts.update:deps: npm install --include=dev --no-save && npm run install:agent && cd client && npm install --include=dev --no-save
